theme_strategy: ARCHETYPE 4: SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST (Dark Mode Priority for QA Dashboard)

typography.headings_font: Chivo, or IBM Plex Sans (Offline fallback to system-ui)
typography.mono_font: JetBrains Mono, or IBM Plex Mono (Offline fallback to ui-monospace)

visual_enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look). Expose the skeleton. Use `border-collapse` style layout with subtle `border-zinc-800` borders dividing sections.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Rely on 1px borders to separate surfaces. Flat solid backgrounds to prevent data distortion (No glassmorphism).
visual_enhancers.hover_states: Slight brightness increase. `hover:bg-zinc-800/50` for interactive rows. Explicit text color definitions on hover.

grids.bento_grid: MODE B: High Density Grid. Compact spacing (`gap-4` to `gap-6`). Every pixel must be utilized. No jagged bottoms.

layouts.global: Sidebar on left (w-64, fixed) for navigation and batch overview. Main content area (flex-1) with sticky header (z-50) for Context/Action (Export PDF, Actions).
layouts.diff_view: 2-column High Density Grid (`grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2`). Left: DOCX Mockup Source, Right: EML/MSG Output. Use subgrid or exact fixed widths for side-by-side exact alignment.
layouts.spacing: Dense Spacing Strategy (`p-4` or `p-6` inside panels). Generous spacing only on the outer dashboard shell.

component_name.DiffRow: Custom component showing side-by-side text with inline mismatch highlights. Wrap additions/deletions in semantic accent colors.
component_name.GlossaryEditor: Data table via Shadcn. Inline editable cells for 'Original' and 'Variation'.
component_name.UploadZone: Dashed border drop zone. `border-2 border-dashed border-zinc-700 hover:border-zinc-500 bg-zinc-900/50`. SVG icon centered.
component_name.StatusBadge: Small rounded pill showing Match/Mismatch/Warning state using the accent palette.

motion.interactions: Instant or very fast (`duration-150`). Code reviewers hate slow animations. Staggered fade-ins for list items only.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text contrast on diff highlights passes APCA (WCAG AA min 4.5:1). Dark mode accents must be bright enough (`-400` tailwind colors).
accessibility.focus: High visibility focus rings: `focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-white focus-visible:ring-offset-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-[#0A0A0B]`.
accessibility.data_testid_rules: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="upload-docx-button"`).

media.offline_support_note: CRITICAL: The app must run OFFLINE. DO NOT use external image URLs (e.g., Unsplash). Use local SVG icons. Font imports should fallback to standard system fonts (system-ui, ui-monospace) if offline.

3d_libraries.usage: None. Keep the interface 2D, dense, and hyper-functional. 3D is distracting for QA.

instructions_to_main_agent: Prioritize data clarity and side-by-side alignment in the Diff Viewer.
Implement the 'Technical Look' with grid borders and flat UI. Avoid generic Vercel gradients.
Ensure 'Batch Upload' accepts both folders and ZIPs visually with distinct icons.
Include export buttons (PDF, CSV) prominently in the top right of the sticky header.
Make the Glossary variations editable via Shadcn inputs.
Ensure the Diff highlights wrap text securely and break long URLs to prevent layout shifts.
Do NOT build a Datepicker or Dialog from scratch. Use Shadcn components and customize their CSS.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Left-align dense content.
Create depth through 1px crisp borders and z-index hierarchy, NOT heavy soft shadows.
MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all.
MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
NEVER use emoji characters for icons. Use lucide-react.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, selection states.
ALL interactive elements MUST have `data-testid` attribute.
DO NOT use complete `transparent` background in header, overlays, any surface that has content under it.
